To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Triton X100 alters the resistance to oxacilline in MRSA strains.
Triton X 100 affects the resistance level of S. aureus to oxalillin.
Triton X100 alters the resistance levels of 17 methicillin-resistant isolates to oxacillin, but not the lysostaphin sensitivity of heat-inactivated cells of the isolates.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of the surfactant Triton X- 100 on the resistance level of MRSA to oxacillin.
the effects of Tritons on the resistance level of MRSA.
a novel method for the detection of methicillin- resistant S. aureus.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Triton X 100 affects the resistance level of oxacillin of methicillinresistant S. aureus by altering a factor(s) that is different from those that are affected by other surfactants, and by altering the cell wall of the bacteria.
Triton X100 affects a factor(s) which is involved in the resistance of S. aureus to oxalacillin, but the nature of this factor remains to be elucidated.

Triton X100 is a non-specific detergent which can alter the resistance of methicillinresistant S. aureus to oxycillin by influencing a factor ( s) other than PBPS, bacteriolytis enzymes, or fem AB products.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Triton X 100 alters the level of oxacillin resistance of methicillin- resistant S. aureus, and that the alteration is not due to changes in the activity of PBPs, bacteriolysins, or femAB.
Triton X 100 affects the level of methicillins resistance in methicillin-resistant staphylococci by altering the resistance level of S. aureus to ox acillin.
Triton X100 is a detergent that alters the level of resistance of methicillin resistant S. aureus by a mechanism that is yet to be elucidated.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Triton X100 can alter the resistance level of MRSA, and that this alteration is not mediated by the PBP2a, femAB products, bacteriolytics, or heat shock proteins.
Triton X100 is an important factor to consider when testing the resistance of methicillin resistant S. aureus to antibiotics.
Triton X100 is a good tool in the fight against methicillin-resistant staphylococcus.
